relations.evidence: You should always run [rebalance](couchbase-cli-rebalance.md) after running this command.

notable_absence.finding: Moving servers between groups changes replica placement/failure-domain topology cluster-wide, yet group-manage.md states no RBAC role or permission requirement at all - the same CLI-tree-wide absence pattern already seen on cluster-edit.md, server-add.md and server-readd.md in this batch.

cross_component_finding: Two small, concrete copyediting/spec artifacts on this page, consistent with lighter TW review. (1) A grammar slip in the --to-group description: 'This group must already exists.' (subject-verb disagreement - should read 'must already exist'). (2) A SYNOPSIS/OPTIONS mismatch: the SYNOPSIS lists --move-servers as a bare flag with no value placeholder ('[--move-servers]'), but the OPTIONS section describes it as '--move-servers <server_list>' - a flag that clearly takes a required argument. A reader relying on the SYNOPSIS alone would not know --move-servers needs a value.
cross_product_finding: Plainly none - server groups (rack/availability-zone-aware replica placement) are a self-managed Server, Enterprise-Edition-only concept per the already-promoted server:server-group record; this page gives no indication of any Capella equivalent.
